title: About Handoff | Latin American talent inside US companies
headline: Who we
lead: Handoff is a team of Latin American professionals placing talent like ourselves inside US companies.
leadStrong: Our own team is built from the same people we find for our clients.

goal.body: talented people across Latin America doing meaningful, valuable work, one placement at a time.

purpose.headline: What holds us together
purpose.lead: The work connects us, and that connection makes the work we do
purpose.body: Every placement opens a door for the next person, and the people who walk through it become the ones who hold it open next.

alma.body: It's the name of our internal platform and how we see every person we place:
alma.struck: not a profile in a database,

gap.headline: Talent is everywhere. Opportunity isn't.
gap.body: Skilled professionals live everywhere. The chance to work with great companies doesn't reach all of them. Handoff closes that gap.

winWin.headline: A win on both sides

sides.title: For the companies we work with
sides.body: Many of our clients don't have the budget for every seat they need, so they get stuck and can't scale. With Handoff, they bring on the talent to grow, and to compete with bigger companies in their industry that have bigger budgets.

sides.title: For the professionals we place
sides.body: Our talent is paid above market, works with some of the best companies in the world, and keeps growing with upskilling from us.

winWin.closer: Hearing clients talk about how far they've scaled, and hearing the talent talk about what the role opened up for them, is why we do this.

founder.headline: The founder
founder.body: Anthony "AG" Gonzalez has spent his career building teams across borders. Along the way, he saw exceptional talent and growing companies in need of that talent, continually missing each other. His turning point was realizing that when the two connect, both win. Companies gain the people they need to scale, and professionals gain the opportunity their talent has earned. That's why he started Handoff: so leaders can focus on what they do best and hand off the rest.

items.name: Humanize
items.line: People come first in everything we do.

items.name: Connect
items.line: Relationships are the heart of our business.

close: We are the team behind your team. We do the sourcing, screening, and support, so you can bring on talent with confidence and keep your focus on the work.
seoDescription: Handoff places Latin America's top talent inside US companies, and stays with you after they're placed to support them so they last.
